##### Project general facts

Umalas Reserve is a boutique residential project, designed as a refined collection of modern villas that blend industrial architecture with tropical elements. The project features reinforced concrete structures combined with steel elements, creating a solid and contemporary architectural identity. Natural materials such as stone, wood, and textured finishes are used throughout the exterior, including gray random stone, Kerobokan stone, breeze blocks, and ulin wood accents. The overall design emphasizes durability, clean geometry, and a seamless integration with the surrounding environment.

The project is designed to provide a comfortable and functional living experience with a focus on privacy and everyday convenience. Each villa includes a private swimming pool equipped with a filtration system, landscaped outdoor areas, and dedicated parking spaces. engineering solutions include high-quality water supply systems, anti-termite protection, reliable electrical infrastructure, and efficient cooling systems. The use of durable construction technologies and well-planned layouts ensures long-term comfort of living in a tropical climate.

Interiors at Umalas Reserve reflect a modern tropical style with high-quality natural finishes and carefully selected materials. Spaces feature limestone flooring, granite tiles, solid wood panels, and mosaic stone accents, creating a warm and tactile environment. Wooden ceilings and neutral-toned walls enhance the sense of openness, while details such as pebble stone in bathrooms and green mosaic kitchen backsplashes add character. The villas are delivered with high-quality sanitary fittings (Germany Brilliant, Crown Prince, Ahti level) and fully finished interiors, offering a refined, move-in-ready space without unnecessary excess.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Umalas is a highly sought-after residential area known for its tranquility and green atmosphere, strategically located between the vibrant hubs of Canggu and Seminyak. This unique positioning allows residents to enjoy privacy and tranquility while remaining just minutes away from Bali’s best beach clubs, restaurants, and lifestyle destinations. Umalas is especially popular among expats and long-term residents who value a more relaxed environment without sacrificing accessibility.

The area is characterized by low-density development, rice field views, and a well-balanced mix of modern villas and boutique residences. Unlike the busier neighboring districts, Umalas offers wider streets, less traffic, and a more residential feel, making it ideal for families and those seeking a comfortable everyday lifestyle. At the same time, it provides easy access to international schools, fitness centers, cafés, and essential infrastructure, supporting both living and long-term stays.

Umalas continues to grow in popularity due to its strong rental demand and limited supply of quality real estate. Its central location, combined with a peaceful setting, makes it one of the most attractive areas for both living and investment in Bali. As development expands and surrounding districts become more saturated, Umalas stands out as a balanced and promising location offering long-term value and a high quality of life.
